title: Boyos Wonderland at Club UP
description: Boyos Wonderland brings house, disco, Afro-Caribbean rhythms and leftfield club sounds to Club UP for its first Amsterdam edition on 18 September 2026.
detailsLabel: Tickets are on sale now from €8 plus service fee.
intro: Club UP, 23:00. House runs through the night, but never sets the boundaries. Disco, Afro-Caribbean rhythms, deeper cuts and leftfield club sounds move through the room with Boyos Soundsystem, Ferkoel and Damian Zico B2B Vince Fajardo behind the decks.
The first Boyos Wonderland in Amsterdam. Come early, stay late.
body: Boyos Wonderland takes over Club UP for its first Amsterdam edition.
After a run of parties, Dine & Dance nights and mini-festivals in Haarlem, Wonderland moves into the centre of Amsterdam for a full club night.

For this edition, house is a strong thread, not a limitation. The night can move between house, disco, Afro-Caribbean rhythms, deeper cuts and leftfield club sounds, with each artist bringing their own direction to the floor.
Boyos Soundsystem hosts the night and is joined by Ferkoel and Damian Zico B2B Vince Fajardo.
No need to pin it down much further than that. The room opens at 23:00 and from there the night gets to develop on its own terms.
